ai.title: Unify Sites tool schemas and validate argument names in client
ai.summary: The Sites subsystem now defines tool argument constraints once in `SITE_ARGS` within `common/src/sites/tools.ts`, replacing separate bare string schemas in tool specs with strict Zod types (UUIDs, binding regexes, and length bounds). The `SitesClient` in `common/src/sites/client.ts` now imports these shared schemas instead of maintaining local duplicates, and uses a new `field` helper to wrap individual argument validations so that Zod errors explicitly name the rejected argument. When a request fails validation, the client returns a message listing the specific argument paths that failed rather than a generic error, preventing models from retrying identical calls. This synchronization ensures the constraints exposed to models in tool definitions match exactly what the client enforces.
